reasons: The 3D graphics consist of generic walking avatars and numbered blocks, failing to visually explain the specific constitutional provisions (Articles 343, 351, 347) narrated in the audio.

An arrow turns toward the green platform revealing Article 343 as the correct answer.
The character stands beside a book labeled 'संविधान' while text explains Article 351.
Three numbered blocks (351, 347, 343) stand under a structure while audio and text explain Article 347.
